name: Big n Blind Finprov 2026
information: * **The competition will be held on the 2nd floor of the Complex** * **Make sure you are at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late.** * **All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition** * **If you are participating in a WCA competition for the first time or are not familiar with the competition rules, please go through the WCA Regulations** * **If you are participating in a WCA Competition for the first time, please bring your official govt. ID card as well.** * **Food is strictly prohibited at the venue** * **Strictly litter-free zone**
